name: Tumble Wash Laundromat

notes.Price: Listing ask (BizBuySell #2564518). Change to test offers.
notes.AllocEquip: Estimate: ~69 machines at 15 yrs old; support with a distributor appraisal. Seller will want this low (recapture).
notes.SelfServe: P&L $18,000/mo; listing $4,150/wk. Verify with 24 months of CCI card-system reports.
notes.WFLbsMonth: P&L ~8,000 lb/mo (listing 1,846 lb/wk). Verify in Cents POS.
notes.SoapVend: P&L $1,250/mo. NJ sales tax applies to detergent; confirm whether P&L figure is net of tax.
notes.RentYr1: $2,758/mo per listing; +~3%/yr; ~17 yrs left. Confirm escalation date and that sewer is truly included (P&L says so).
notes.Wage: NJ minimum wage $16.48 from 1/1/2027; local attendants ~$16.50-18 (research/opex.md). P&L uses $16.50.
notes.Burden: research/opex.md: ~16% all-in. P&L shows N/A for payroll tax and WC.
notes.WaterYr1: P&L $2,700/mo. JCMUA rates rise ~5%/yr (2026 $17.82 per 1,000 gal combined).
notes.GasElecYr1: P&L $2,700/mo on the 'Gas' line, electric marked 'Inc'. Our read: one combined PSE&G bill. If electric is extra, add it in the next row.
notes.ElecExtra: Set to ~$10-15k if 12 months of PSE&G bills show electric is billed separately.
notes.UtilCont: Assumption until 12-24 months of bills are reviewed.
notes.UtilSave: Equipment thread: new washers ~25% less water/energy; blended ~20%.
notes.RepairsYr1: P&L $5,400/yr looks owner-subsidized; equipment thread ~$8k + parts/outside techs.
notes.ProFees: Not in P&L. Two depreciation books (federal + NJ) and a partnership return.
notes.OwnerHours: Assumption. 500+ hrs/yr (~10/wk) is the material-participation test. Broker: plan 10-15 hrs/wk even 'absentee'.
notes.HandoffYear: Ryan: full-time in Year 1, then train staff to take over.
notes.OwnerHoursLater: Default 40 = no hand-off. Ryan's plan: ~10 (management, books, marketing, contracts).
notes.DelivLbsFull: Default 0 = off. Plan: 5,000 lb/mo (e.g. ~60 residential customers + 2-4 Airbnb/gym/restaurant accounts).
notes.DelivPrice: Jersey City delivery $1.25-1.49 at local stores, app services ~$2.65 (research/opex.md); commercial linens taxable 6.625% (passed through).
notes.CapexScenario: Equipment thread (revised): washers ~15 yrs old vs 12-15 yr CLA average, so replace in yrs 1-4; base yr 4 (/mnt/project-files/equipment/README.md s.2).
notes.RyanFed: Placeholder. Depends on Ryan's other income. Please confirm.
notes.RyanOtherInc: Structure memo: ~$50k role at the parents' practice. Losses above this become an NOL carryforward.
notes.SSBase: SSA. Grown with wages in the model.
notes.RyanSalary: Assumption; grows with wages. Must be defensible for ~40 hrs/wk management + attendant work.
notes.SCorpPayroll: 15.3% + ~3.0% (research/opex.md); JC 1% does not apply if Ryan lives in Jersey City.

broker_pnl.stated_noi_note: P&L TOTAL omits vending COGS, dry cleaning cost and card fees ($1,275/mo). Lines added correctly give $162,420.

wf.why: Same in Year 1; price increase starts Year 2.

wages.why: P&L: 91 hrs x $16.50. 2027 NJ minimum wage is $16.48, so $17.50 to keep staff.

water.why: Plus 10% contingency until bills are seen.

rep.why: 15-yr fleet; seller likely does own repairs unpaid.

ins.why: $240/mo is too low for property + GL + equipment breakdown.

tel.why: Underwritten adds the $375/yr fire alarm noted on the P&L.

opex.why: Broker's lines add to $17,815/mo; the P&L's TOTAL says $16,540.

multiples: Low (old fleet, NYC metro sold median less)
Rule of thumb, 15+ yr lease, low rent
valuation.source: Sources: underwriting/research/comps.md (BizBuySell Insight 855 deals; 28 NYC-metro listings; Laundromat Resource rules of thumb)
